title: Fluid-Gen-Zero: Grounding Pretrained Video Generators in Physics without Training
title_zh: Fluid-Gen-Zero：无需训练即可将物理知识融入预训练视频生成器

paragraphs.en: We present Fluid-Gen-Zero , a training-free framework for physics-aware fluid-object interaction video generation that decouples physical reasoning from appearance synthesis. Our key insight is to delegate motion dynamics to a physics simulator while preserving the appearance modeling capacity of pretrained video generators. We bridge these two domains through a two-level agentic workflow: generation-time planning, where a vision-language model (VLM) agent interprets intent and the simulation rollout to organize generation clips, and latent-space guidance, which injects simulation signals into denoising through region-aware latent wrapping. This plug-and-play design is compatible with current video foundation models. We further introduce a benchmark for fluid-object interaction video generation. Across Tora (CogVideoX-based), VACE and WanMove (Wan-based), Fluid-Gen-Zero consistently improves simulation alignment, reducing object trajectory error by 26.7%–81.5% and fluid fEPE (fluid flow endpoint error) by 67.9%–84.0% , while largely preserving perceptual quality. In a human preference study, raters favor Fluid-Gen-Zero in 55.1%–74.4% of same-backbone comparisons across three backbones, and in 90.4%–94.2% of comparisons against simulation-based methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

paragraphs.en: Video foundation models (VFMs) achieve remarkable visual fidelity [ 48 , 1 , 7 , 39 , 12 , 19 ] , yet they are not inherently grounded in physical laws. This challenge is particularly evident in fluid-object interactions, where complex, deformable dynamics cannot be reliably inferred from text or standard diffusion priors [ 35 , 6 , 15 ] . Consequently, state-of-the-art generators frequently produce visually appealing but physically implausible motion [ 29 , 4 , 42 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 视频基础模型（VFMs）实现了令人瞩目的视觉保真度 [ 48 , 1 , 7 , 39 , 12 , 19 ]，但它们本身并非基于物理定律。 这一挑战在流体与物体的相互作用中尤为明显，因为复杂且可形变的动态过程无法通过文本或标准的扩散先验可靠地推断出来 [ 35 , 6 , 15 ]。 因此，当前最先进的生成模型经常产生视觉上吸引人但物理上不合逻辑的运动 [ 29 , 4 , 42 ]。

paragraphs.en: To bridge this gap, recent works inject physical priors through fine-tuning [ 29 , 4 , 42 , 20 ] , preference optimization [ 10 , 8 , 47 ] , or auxiliary objectives [ 23 , 13 , 26 , 49 , 9 , 46 ] . While these methods improve physical grounding, their reliance on architecture-coupled post-training presents scalability challenges . First , updating the weights of massive video generators incurs prohibitive costs in computation and training data collection. Second , as VFMs scale and evolve at an unprecedented pace, maintaining architecture-coupled post-training paradigms becomes increasingly unsustainable. An architecture-specific physics adapter trained today risks immediate obsolescence when a new VFM is released tomorrow, a dynamic reminiscent of the “bitter lesson” [ 37 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，近期研究通过微调 [ 29 , 4 , 42 , 20 ]、偏好优化 [ 10 , 8 , 47 ] 或辅助目标 [ 23 , 13 , 26 , 49 , 9 , 46 ] 引入了物理先验知识。 尽管这些方法提升了物理基础，但它们对与架构耦合的后训练方法的依赖带来了可扩展性挑战。 首先，更新大规模视频生成器的权重会产生高昂的计算和训练数据收集成本。 其次，随着视频生成模型以前所未有的速度扩展和演进，维持与架构耦合的后训练范式正变得日益不可持续。 今天训练的特定架构物理适配器，一旦明天发布新的视频生成模型，就可能立即过时——这种动态变化让人联想到“苦涩的教训”[ 37 ]。

paragraphs.en: How to bridge pretrained video generators and physics awareness without training?
paragraphs.zh: 如何在无需训练的情况下，架起预训练视频生成器与物理感知之间的桥梁？

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose Fluid-Gen-Zero , a training-free framework that decouples physical reasoning from appearance synthesis, enabling plug-and-play physics awareness across production-level video generators in fluid scenes. Our intervention is logically based on two universally accessible handles: the generation timeline and the internal denoising trajectory.

paragraphs.en: Physics-based simulators, from classical SPH/PBF and MPM solvers [ 30 , 36 , 6 , 35 , 15 ] to engines such as MuJoCo, Taichi, Warp, and Genesis [ 40 , 16 , 27 , 3 ] , model fluid dynamics and multi-material coupling while preserving causality and contact, but they require explicit geometry and materials and do not synthesize open-vocabulary appearance. Video foundation models [ 48 , 39 , 7 , 12 , 19 , 1 ] provide high visual quality, and controllable variants condition on masks, depth, drags, or trajectories [ 45 , 22 , 24 , 31 ] , as in MotionCtrl [ 44 ] , Tora [ 50 ] , MagicMotion [ 21 ] , WanMove [ 11 ] , and ATI [ 41 ] , or use training-free schedules, as in MotionCraft [ 33 ] and Time-to-Move [ 34 ] ; these image- or latent-space controls do not determine physically valid 3D dynamics. Physics-informed generators improve physical consistency through fine-tuning and preference optimization [ 29 , 42 , 20 , 10 , 8 ] , inference-time reasoning [ 47 ] , or simulation: WonderPlay [ 23 ] optimizes explicit 4D representations, PSIVG [ 13 ] applies test-time optimization to reconstructed templates, RealWonder [ 26 ] and PerpetualWonder [ 49 ] condition distilled or long-horizon generators on simulation, and PhysGen3D [ 9 ] and PhysAnimator [ 46 ] animate images with simulation. These pipelines rely on model-specific training, test-time optimization, or explicit scene representations, whereas Fluid-Gen-Zero couples simulation with frozen video generators through a training-free, plug-and-play interface.

paragraphs.en: Fluid-Gen-Zero is a training-free image-to-video framework for fluid-object interaction video generation. Given an input image I 0 I_{0} , an input prompt p p , and a frozen pretrained video generator G θ G_{\theta} , it produces a realistic video that follows both the prompt and a plausible physical rollout. The framework decouples physical motion from appearance synthesis. The simulator determines what moves and when. The generator determines how the scene looks. As shown in Figure 2 , Fluid-Gen-Zero connects simulation and generation in three stages. First , it reconstructs a simulation-ready scene from I 0 I_{0} and p p . It then rolls out the fluid-object dynamics to obtain a simulation rollout 𝒮 \mathcal{S} ( Sec. 3.2 ). Second , generation-time planning divides the long rollout into generation clips. paragraphs.en: Generation-time planning converts one simulation rollout into a sequence of generation clips that are stitched into a long-horizon video. VFMs support bounded clip lengths, while the difficulty of fluid motion varies substantially over time. Smooth motion allows flexible boundary placement. Abrupt events, such as contact, splashing, and occlusion, should remain within one clip rather than be split across two generations. Accordingly, the planner asks a simple question: where is it safe to cut? A safe boundary lies in a temporally stable region. A risky boundary falls inside or near an important physical event. Splitting at such a boundary can introduce motion discontinuity or event inconsistency because the neighboring clips are generated independently. Given the input prompt p p , intent record ℐ \mathcal{I} , and simulation rollout 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , Fluid-Gen-Zero estimates boundary risk over time. It then produces a clip plan Π = { ( s i , e i , p i ) } i = 1 N clip \Pi=\{(s_{i},e_{i},p_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N_{\mathrm{clip}}} containing N clip N_{\mathrm{clip}} clips. Here, ( s i , e i ) (s_{i},e_{i}) specifies the temporal extent of clip i i , and p i p_{i} is its clip-level prompt. Figure 3 illustrates the workflow. Figure 6 shows a representative planning result.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Fluid-Gen-Zero on a simulation-driven benchmark of 43 fluid-object interaction samples. Unless otherwise specified, we use 401-frame simulation rollouts for long-horizon generation. We instantiate the complete Fluid-Gen-Zero framework on three backbones: VACE [ 18 ] (1.3B), Tora [ 50 ] (5B), and WanMove [ 11 ] (14B). We additionally compare against the simulation-based methods PhysGen3D [ 9 ] and WonderPlay [ 23 ] , and the training-free method MotionCraft [ 33 ] . More implementation and benchmark details are provided in Appendix 4 and 5 .

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Simulation alignment is measured by object trajectory error, the mean per-frame L1 distance in pixels between generated and simulated object centroids, and fluid flow endpoint error (fEPE) [ 14 ] between simulation and generated-video optical flow over the fluid region, since a single fluid centroid is ill-defined once the fluid spreads. We also report VBench subject consistency, temporal flickering, aesthetic quality, and image quality [ 17 ] , VideoPhy2 physical commonsense [ 5 ] , a GPT judge [ 9 ] for physical realism (PhysR), photorealism (PhotoR), and semantic consistency (Sem), and a human preference study ( Sec. 4.3 ). More results are provided in Appendix 6 .

paragraphs.en: Simulation-aligned video generation across VFM backbones. Table 1 shows that Fluid-Gen-Zero consistently improves simulation alignment across all three VFM backbones. The largest gains appear on Tora and WanMove, whose backbones are conditioned on sparse motion trajectories: object trajectory error decreases from 133.20 133.20 to 24.61 24.61 and from 92.93 92.93 to 23.08 23.08 , and fluid fEPE from 3.950 3.950 to 0.843 0.843 and from 5.180 5.180 to 0.827 0.827 , respectively. These results indicate that sparse motion trajectories can specify where an object should move but cannot maintain the complete object-fluid evolution over time. Fluid-Gen-Zero closes much of this gap by anchoring the denoising trajectory to the noised reference latent within each generation clip.

paragraphs.en: Comparison with simulation-based and training-free methods. PhysGen3D simulates object motion and composites the rendered object over the background but leaves the surrounding fluid largely static. WonderPlay relies on per-scene representation fitting and refinement, making simulation or fitting errors visible in the final appearance. MotionCraft is also training-free and simulation-driven, but performs frame-wise latent warping with an image diffusion model; without a video prior or longer-range constraints, errors accumulate as motion drift and appearance inconsistency. In contrast, Fluid-Gen-Zero retains the pretrained generator’s appearance prior while using simulation to constrain both object motion and fluid appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 与基于模拟和无训练方法的比较。 PhysGen3D 模拟物体运动，并将渲染后的物体叠加到背景上，但周围的流体基本保持静态。 WonderPlay 依赖每场景的表示拟合与优化，导致模拟或拟合错误在最终外观中显现。 MotionCraft 同样无需训练且以模拟驱动，但它通过图像扩散模型对每一帧进行潜在空间形变；由于缺乏视频先验或更长范围的约束，错误会累积为运动漂移和外观不一致。 相比之下，Fluid-Gen-Zero 保留了预训练生成器的外观先验，同时利用模拟来约束物体运动和流体外观。

paragraphs.en: Why physical commonsense scores can be misleading. An important observation is that some conventional quality metrics can assign high scores to visually stable or superficially plausible motion even when the underlying dynamics are physically implausible . PhysGen3D achieves the highest temporal flickering score because its simulated object is composited over a largely static background, so most pixels change little over time even though the surrounding fluid remains almost frozen. PhysGen3D and MotionCraft obtain the two highest VideoPhy2 physical commonsense scores despite clear failures in our qualitative results.
paragraphs.zh: 物理常识分数为何可能具有误导性。 一个重要的观察是，一些传统的指标可能会在底层动力学不符合物理规律的情况下，仍对视觉上稳定或表面看似合理的运动给出高分。 PhysGen3D 获得了最高的时间闪烁分数，因为其模拟对象叠加在一个基本静态的背景上，因此尽管周围的流体几乎静止不动，大多数像素随时间的变化也非常小。 尽管在我们的定性结果中出现了明显的失败，PhysGen3D 和 MotionCraft 仍然获得了 VideoPhy2 物理常识分数中的前两名。

paragraphs.en: This behavior is partly explained by the evaluation protocol. VideoPhy2 evaluates physical commonsense separately from prompt adherence [ 5 ] and can therefore favor smooth, conservative motion. PhysGen3D inherits smooth object trajectories directly from simulation, while MotionCraft propagates appearance through frame-to-frame latent warping; both mechanisms suppress abrupt motion but do not guarantee realistic long-horizon fluid-object dynamics. The GPT judge, which considers physical realism together with photorealism and semantic consistency, is more sensitive to cases where motion looks locally smooth but the complete generated interaction remains physically or visually implausible. Accordingly, both methods rank among the lowest in GPT Overall, whereas all three Fluid-Gen-Zero variants achieve higher scores. Figure 5 shows these differences: PhysGen3D moves the object over an essentially frozen fluid, WonderPlay introduces substantial appearance distortion, and MotionCraft exhibits accumulated drift and flickering.
paragraphs.zh: 这种行为部分可以通过评估协议来解释。 VideoPhy2 将物理常识与提示遵循性分开评估 [5]，因此可能更倾向于平稳、保守的运动。 PhysGen3D 直接从模拟中继承物体的平滑轨迹，而 MotionCraft 则通过帧间潜在形变传播外观；这两种机制都能抑制突兀的运动，但无法保证长时程下流体与物体之间具有真实的动态交互。 GPT 评判器会同时考虑物理真实感、照片级真实感和语义一致性，因此对那些局部运动看似平滑，但整体生成的交互过程在物理或视觉上仍不合理的情况更为敏感。 因此，这两种方法在 GPT 综合评分中均排名靠后，而三种 Fluid-Gen-Zero 变体则都获得了更高的分数。 图 5 展示了这些差异：PhysGen3D 让物体在几乎静止的流体上移动，WonderPlay 出现了显著的外观失真，而 MotionCraft 则表现出累积的漂移和闪烁。

paragraphs.en: How generation-time planning adapts to physical complexity. Figure 6 illustrates the planning behavior for a rotating fig that first contacts the fluid surface and then flings droplets outward. The temporal complexity curve rises sharply around the main interaction at approximately frames 180 180 – 200 200 . The planner marks this span as a protected event interval and moves the clip boundary to a safer region. It uses longer clips in the lower-complexity portions before and after the event. This result shows how generation-time planning adapts clip boundaries to the temporal structure of the simulation rollout instead of uniformly segmenting it.
paragraphs.zh: 生成时规划如何适应物理复杂性。 图 6 展示了旋转物体在首次接触流体表面后将液滴向外甩出的规划行为。 时间复杂度曲线在约第 180–200 帧的主交互点附近急剧上升。 规划器将此区间标记为受保护的事件区间，并将剪辑边界移至更安全的区域。 它在事件前后较低复杂度的部分使用更长的剪辑。 这一结果表明，生成时规划如何根据模拟展开的时间结构来调整剪辑边界，而不是对时间进行均匀分割。

paragraphs.en: We presented Fluid-Gen-Zero , a training-free framework that uses simulation as a structural motion prior for frozen video generators through generation-time planning and region-aware latent wrapping, improving simulation alignment, temporal consistency, and human preference across backbones without updating generator parameters. Limitations. Guidance quality depends on reconstruction and simulation accuracy (Appendix 6.4 ); projected masks and optical flow underspecify fine-grained fluid-solid coupling; and long rollouts may still accumulate appearance or camera drift across clips.

paragraphs.en: Pose refinement against the waterline. The initial pose does not account for fluid occlusion. Because the fluid can hide the submerged portion of the object, the observed mask stops at the waterline. Scoring the full rendered silhouette against this mask would penalize a correctly predicted submerged region and displace the object upward. We therefore clip the mesh by the fitted fluid plane and score only the region that should be visible, combining silhouette agreement above the surface with a depth residual. paragraphs.en: During intent parsing, the VLM uses the prompt semantics to produce one non-negative priority for each family.

paragraphs.en: We average the normalized priorities with the fixed prior w ¯ = ( 0.40 , 0.40 , 0.20 ) \bar{w}=(0.40,0.40,0.20) over the physical, visual, and semantic families, using equal weights, then renormalize the result.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对物理、视觉和语义这三个类别的归一化优先级，使用固定先验 w ¯ = ( 0.40 , 0.40 , 0.20 ) \bar{w}=(0.40,0.40,0.20) 和相等的权重进行平均，然后对结果进行重新归一化。

paragraphs.en: The resulting sequence { C t } t = 1 T − 1 \{C_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T-1} is the final temporal complexity curve used for boundary selection. The planner combines this curve with the semantic annotations to construct the no-cut boundary set 𝒰 \mathcal{U} . A candidate boundary b b is added to 𝒰 \mathcal{U} when the preceding transition satisfies C b − 1 ≥ 0.72 C_{b-1}\geq 0.72 , when b b lies strictly inside a parsed event with importance at least 0.75 0.75 , or when it lies strictly inside a VLM interval marked as no-cut. We refer to the latter two types of intervals as protected event intervals.

paragraphs.en: Once clip boundaries are fixed, a separate VLM call produces optional clip-level prompt refinements. For each selected clip, the planner starts from the input prompt p p , keeps the global scene description, and uses the semantic events and dominant risk tags within the clip to request a local refinement. The resulting clip-level prompt p i p_{i} preserves subject identity, material, background, lighting, and camera framing, then appends local physical emphasis. For example, a contact-heavy interval emphasizes boundary consistency and stable contact geometry, a splash-heavy interval emphasizes droplets and thin fluid sheets, and a topology-change interval emphasizes coherent splitting or merging. The final metadata for each clip contains ( s i , e i ) (s_{i},e_{i}) , the clip-level prompt p i p_{i} , a risk summary, event tags, the relevant entries of 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , and the simulation-derived generation conditions passed to latent-space guidance. For long-horizon generation, the last generated frame of clip i i is reused as the anchor frame for clip i + 1 i+1 when the backbone supports image anchoring. After generation, the duplicated anchor frame is removed before stitching. This anchor frame reduces clip-boundary drift without requiring backbone fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦剪辑边界确定，就会通过一次独立的 VLM 调用生成可选的剪辑级提示优化。 对于每个选定的剪辑，规划器从输入提示 p p 开始，保留全局场景描述，并利用剪辑内的语义事件和主要风险标签请求局部优化。 生成的剪辑级提示 p i p_{i} 会保留主体身份、材质、背景、光照和镜头构图，然后附加局部的物理强调信息。 例如，接触频繁的区间会强调边界一致性和稳定的接触几何结构；溅射频繁的区间会强调液滴和薄流体层；拓扑变化区间则会强调连贯的分裂或合并。 每个剪辑的最终元数据包含 ( s i , e i ) (s_{i},e_{i})、剪辑级提示 p i p_{i}、风险摘要、事件标签、𝒰 \mathcal{U} 的相关条目，以及传递给潜在空间引导的模拟生成的生成条件。 对于长时程生成，如果主干模型支持图像锚定，剪辑 i i 的最后一帧生成画面会被重新用作剪辑 i + 1 i+1 的锚定帧。 生成后，在拼接前会移除重复的锚定帧。 这种锚定帧方法无需对主干模型进行微调，即可减少剪辑边界处的漂移。

For the flow-matching backbones, γ k = 1 − σ k \gamma_{k}=1-\sigma_{k} . sents.en: We therefore construct the noised reference latent as z k sim = γ k ​ z sim + σ k ​ ϵ z^{\mathrm{sim}}_{k}=\gamma_{k}z^{\mathrm{sim}}+\sigma_{k}\epsilon , where ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝐈 ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I}) has the same shape as z sim z^{\mathrm{sim}} , and ( γ k , σ k ) (\gamma_{k},\sigma_{k}) are obtained from the backbone’s forward-process scheduler.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将含噪参考潜在变量构建为 z k sim = γ k ​ z sim + σ k ​ ϵ z^{\mathrm{sim}}_{k}=\gamma_{k}z^{\mathrm{sim}}+\sigma_{k}\epsilon，其中 ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝐈 ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I}) 与 z sim z^{\mathrm{sim}} 形状相同，且 ( γ k , σ k ) (\gamma_{k},\sigma_{k}) 由主干网络的前向过程调度器获得。

sents.en: For the flow-matching backbones, γ k = 1 − σ k \gamma_{k}=1-\sigma_{k} .
sents.zh: 对于流匹配主干网络，γ k = 1 − σ k \gamma_{k}=1-\sigma_{k}。

sents.en: For Tora, γ k = α ¯ k \gamma_{k}=\sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_{k}} and σ k = 1 − α ¯ k \sigma_{k}=\sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}_{k}} , where α ¯ k \bar{\alpha}_{k} is the scheduler’s cumulative signal-retention coefficient.

sents.en: Sampling starts from z k 0 sim z^{\mathrm{sim}}_{k_{0}} , which anchors coarse layout and motion while retaining stochasticity for the generator to synthesize texture, lighting, transparency, and fine detail.
sents.zh: 采样从 z k 0 sim z^{\mathrm{sim}}_{k_{0}} 开始，这既锚定了粗略布局和运动，又保留了随机性，以便生成器能够合成纹理、光照、透明度和精细细节。

After k obj k_{\mathrm{obj}} , the generator refines the object’s appearance without further object-region wrapping.
paragraphs.zh: 对象：二进制，早期。 对于 k₀ ≤ k < k_obj，我们设置 β_k^o = 1；否则 β_k^o = 0。 在 [k₀, k_obj) 期间，带噪声的参考潜在变量会替换 z̃_{k+1} 中的对象区域，从而在整体结构形成的同时，牢固地锚定对象的身份、轮廓和接触几何形状。 在 k_obj 之后，生成器会进一步细化对象的外观，而无需再次对对象区域进行包裹。

paragraphs.en: Simulation. We use Genesis with the object represented as either a rigid body or an elastic MPM material, selected per scene by the VLM from the image and prompt, and the fluid represented as a liquid MPM material. A rigid object keeps its reconstructed mesh and couples to the liquid through the mesh’s signed distance field, whereas an elastic object is filled with MPM particles. The time step is Δ ​ t = 10 − 3 \Delta t=10^{-3} , with 30 30 substeps and gravity set to 9.8 ​ m / s 2 9.8\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}} . Object elasticity, fluid density and viscosity, and force direction and magnitude come from the deterministic rule-based parser.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟。 我们使用 Genesis，其中物体被表示为刚体或弹性 MPM 材料（由 VLM 根据图像和提示按场景选择），而流体则被表示为液体 MPM 材料。 刚体保持其重建的网格，并通过网格的带符号距离场与液体耦合，而弹性物体则由 MPM 粒子填充。 时间步长为 Δ t = 10 − 3 \Delta t=10^{-3}，包含 30 个子步，重力设为 9.8 ​ m / s 2 9.8\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}}。 物体的弹性、流体的密度和黏度，以及力的方向和大小，均来自确定性的规则解析器。

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark contains 43 curated fluid-object interaction samples, all of which are used for the experiments in the main paper. paragraphs.zh: 我们的基准数据集包含 43 个经过精心挑选的流体-物体交互样本，这些样本全部用于主论文中的实验。 每个样本都将一张初始图像和对应的描述文本与一个模拟过程进行配对，该模拟过程包含三维粒子轨迹、物体和流体掩码、投影后的模拟光流、模拟预览以及一个保留外观的变形参考视频。

paragraphs.en: Motion-control benchmarks evaluate whether a generated video follows visual motion annotations. MagicBench provides object masks and bounding boxes [ 21 ] ; MoveBench provides category-balanced videos with first-frame masks and object point tracks [ 11 ] . Both annotate image or video space, and so describe neither fluid state, material-dependent contact, nor coupled object-fluid evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 运动控制基准测试用于评估生成的视频是否遵循视觉运动标注。 MagicBench 提供了物体掩码和边界框 [ 21 ]；MoveBench 则提供了类别均衡的视频，并附带首帧掩码和物体点迹 [ 11 ]。 两者都对图像或视频空间进行了标注，因此既无法描述流体状态，也无法描述依赖材料的接触，更无法描述物体与流体之间的耦合演化。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark targets challenging interaction regimes, including contact, sliding, rotation, impact, submersion, splashing, wake formation, occlusion, viscous deformation, and long-horizon drift. These regimes stress the physical consistency of pretrained generators. Every sample runs through the same reconstruction, rollout, planning, and guidance procedure with no per-scene retuning, so the benchmark measures whether the same configuration generalizes across diverse challenging cases.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试针对具有挑战性的交互模式，包括接触、滑动、旋转、碰撞、浸没、飞溅、尾迹形成、遮挡、黏性形变以及长期漂移。 这些交互模式对预训练生成器的物理一致性提出了严峻考验。 每个样本都经过相同的重建、展开、规划和引导流程，且无需针对每个场景进行重新调整，因此该基准测试旨在衡量同一配置能否在多样化的复杂场景中实现泛化。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Tab. 7 , latent-space guidance substantially improves simulation alignment on Tora, reducing object trajectory error by 81.4% and fluid fEPE by 79.4% . The improvement comes from anchoring the latent trajectory to the noised reference latent during early denoising instead of relying solely on the native backbone condition. Subject consistency and temporal consistency improve substantially, while aesthetic and image quality change only slightly. The asymmetric treatment of object and fluid regions balances physical guidance and generative freedom: strong object anchoring preserves position, silhouette, and contact structure, whereas softer fluid-region wrapping allows more flexibility for fluid appearance synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 7 所示，潜在空间引导显著提升了 Tora 上的模拟对齐效果，将物体轨迹误差降低了 81.4%，流体 fEPE 降低了 79.4%。 这种改进源于在早期去噪阶段将潜在轨迹锚定到含噪声的参考潜在表示上，而非仅依赖原生主干网络的条件。 主体一致性和时间一致性得到了显著提升，而美学和图像质量仅略有变化。 对物体区域和流体区域的不对称处理平衡了物理引导与生成自由度：强物体锚定保留了位置、轮廓和接触结构，而较柔和的流体区域包裹则允许在流体外观合成中拥有更多灵活性。

paragraphs.en: We also ablate two region-aware latent wrapping choices on the Tora backbone. w/o Region-Aware Wrapping removes the spatial distinction between object and fluid regions and applies one wrapping schedule to both. w/o Fluid Wrapping disables fluid-region wrapping while keeping the native backbone condition and object-region wrapping unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还对 Tora 主干网络进行了两种区域感知潜在包裹选择的消融研究。w/o Region-Aware Wrapping（无区域感知包裹）移除了物体区域与流体区域之间的空间区分，并对两者应用相同的包裹方案。w/o Fluid Wrapping（无流体包裹）则禁用了流体区域的包裹操作，同时保留了原始主干网络的条件以及物体区域的包裹设置不变。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 8 confirms the importance of region-aware latent wrapping. The full design achieves the best object trajectory error, fluid fEPE, subject consistency, and aesthetic quality, showing that treating object and fluid regions differently improves simulation alignment without substantially sacrificing appearance. Removing region-aware wrapping degrades both object and fluid alignment, increasing object trajectory error from 24.61 24.61 to 30.40 30.40 and fluid fEPE from 0.843 0.843 to 1.026 1.026 . Disabling fluid wrapping also weakens simulation alignment, although it yields the highest temporal flickering score ( 0.998 0.998 ), suggesting that relaxing fluid constraints gives the pretrained generator more freedom to produce temporally smooth appearance. Overall, these results show that stronger region-specific guidance improves simulation alignment, while relaxing the constraints can benefit individual perceptual metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 表 8 证实了区域感知潜在变量包裹的重要性。 完整的设计在物体轨迹误差、流体 fEPE、主体一致性和美学质量方面均表现最佳，表明对物体和流体区域进行差异化处理能够提升模拟对齐效果，而不会显著牺牲外观质量。 移除区域感知包裹会导致物体和流体的对齐效果均下降：物体轨迹误差从 24.61 增至 30.40，流体 fEPE 从 0.843 增至 1.026。 禁用流体包裹也会削弱模拟对齐效果，尽管它带来了最高的时间闪烁得分（0.998），这表明放松流体约束能为预训练生成器提供更多自由度，从而产生在时间上更平滑的外观。 总体而言，这些结果表明，更强的区域特定指导能够提升模拟对齐效果，而放松约束则可能对某些感知指标有益。

In each sequence, the simulator supplies the coarse physical event order, object trajectory, and fluid spatial extent, while the video generator supplies photorealistic appearance. paragraphs.en: Figure 12 shows a representative failure case of Fluid-Gen-Zero. The most common failures occur when the reconstructed simulator state is physically plausible but not sufficiently aligned with the intended image-prompt scene. For example, segmentation leakage, inaccurate depth near transparent fluid, imperfect object reconstruction, or incorrect pose and scale alignment can produce a simulation rollout whose object-fluid contact timing differs from the visual prompt. In such cases, Fluid-Gen-Zero may still avoid cutting through protected event intervals and inject the noised reference latent, but the generated video can inherit an incorrect coarse spatial layout, show delayed or excessive fluid response, or produce boundary artifacts around contact regions.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 展示了 Fluid-Gen-Zero 的一个典型失败案例。 最常见的失败情况发生在重建的模拟器状态在物理上合理，但与预期图像提示场景的契合度不足时。 例如，分割泄漏、透明流体附近深度不准确、物体重建不完美，或姿态与尺度对齐错误，都可能导致模拟过程产生的物体与流体接触时间与视觉提示不一致。 在这种情况下，Fluid-Gen-Zero 可能仍然能够避免切入受保护的事件区间并注入带噪声的参考潜在变量，但生成的视频仍可能继承错误的粗略空间布局、表现出延迟或过度的流体响应，或在接触区域周围产生边界伪影。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) user study on 8 samples. For each sample, participants are shown the text prompt, input image, simulation preview, and two anonymized generated videos. Method names are hidden and the order of Video A/B is randomized. Each participant completes 34 pairwise trials: six samples are used for the three same-backbone comparisons and eight samples for the two comparisons against simulation-based methods. We collect responses from 13 participants, resulting in 442 pairwise trials and 1326 criterion-level judgments. Figure 10 shows the screen used in the study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 8 个样本进行了一项二选一强制选择（2AFC）的用户研究。 对于每个样本，参与者会看到文本提示、输入图像、模拟预览以及两个匿名化的生成视频。 方法名称被隐藏，且视频 A/B 的顺序是随机排列的。 每位参与者完成 34 次成对试验：其中 6 个样本用于三种相同背骨方法的比较，8 个样本用于两种与基于模拟的方法的比较。 我们从 13 名参与者处收集了反馈，共得到 442 次成对试验和 1326 项标准层级判断。 图 10 展示了研究中使用的界面。

sents.zh: 方法名称被隐藏，且视频 A/B 的顺序是随机排列的。

sents.en: Each participant completes 34 pairwise trials: six samples are used for the three same-backbone comparisons and eight samples for the two comparisons against simulation-based methods.
sents.zh: 每位参与者完成 34 次成对试验：其中 6 个样本用于三种相同背骨方法的比较，8 个样本用于两种与基于模拟的方法的比较。

sents.en: We collect responses from 13 participants, resulting in 442 pairwise trials and 1326 criterion-level judgments.
sents.zh: 我们从 13 名参与者处收集了反馈，共得到 442 次成对试验和 1326 项标准层级判断。

sents.en: Figure 10 shows the screen used in the study.
sents.zh: 图 10 展示了研究中使用的界面。

paragraphs.en: Participants answer three preference questions for each pair. For simulation alignment , they are instructed to focus on object trajectory, fluid motion, interaction timing, splash or swirl behavior, and the order of major events. The generated video does not need to match the visual appearance of the simulation preview exactly. For temporal consistency , they are instructed to focus on flickering, sudden appearance changes, object identity drift, unnatural jumps, broken motion continuity, and visible stitching artifacts. For overall quality , they are instructed to consider visual realism, prompt adherence, temporal consistency, and alignment with the simulation preview.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者需要对每一对示例回答三个偏好问题。 在模拟一致性方面，他们被要求关注物体轨迹、流体运动、交互时机、飞溅或涡旋行为，以及主要事件的发生顺序。 生成的视频无需与模拟预览的视觉外观完全一致。 在时间一致性方面，他们被要求关注闪烁、外观突然变化、物体身份漂移、不自然的跳跃、运动连续性中断以及可见的拼接痕迹。 在整体质量方面，他们被要求考虑视觉真实感、对提示的遵循程度、时间一致性以及与模拟预览的一致性。
